title: Sincere Servants are Dressed with Heavenly Beauty
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, yaa Rijal Allah! Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la
ilaaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Sayyidina wa Nabiyyina Muhammadun Rasoolullah.
Allahuma zidhu `izzan wa sharafan, nooran wa surooran wa ridwaanan wa sultaanan. (Allah, give him more
honor and nobility and light and happiness and power.) (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Madad, yaa Sultan al-Awliya. We are asking heavenly support for addressing to servants of our Lord. May
Allah (swt) grants us and His most beloved and honored servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s) for his
intercession, ask! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) We are asking a guide on this planet, guiding people to
their Lord's Divine Presence, and we are saying, A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem always. O
People! Say this for every badness, for every trouble, because of troublemaker for Mankind, Shaytan. Ask
protection from Shaytan's tricks and traps. Beware of Shaytan. He is so ugly one, if anyone may look his face
now, he must fall down fainting, fainting from ugly appearance for Shaytan. A`oodhu billahi min ashShaytaani ‘r-rajeem.
Most ugly face is for Shaytan, and through Mankind also inherit from Shaytan's ugly face, yes, until ugliness
is going to be naturally. That is something else, but after this there is an appearance, some people have
handsome or beautiful faces, getting down and they are beginning to be seen as an ugly one. And people may

say, “This is a photograph how she was and how she is now." A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem.
Ugly-face people are thrown away from every meeting and every majlis, gathering. They are going to be like a
needle touching people, or you may say like a sabaarah, cactus, how people are taking care not to approach it
because it gives trouble. So many people are going to be in such a way like cactus and shaking people. People
asking to run away from them. Why those people? They are followers of Shaytan and their natural beauties
leaving them and they are going to be like a cactus tree.
But mu'mins, believers, are those who keep their Lord's orders. They are obedient ones and obediency is
dressing them. Even though they are getting older through their outlooking, people never going to be
unhappy from them as they are not disturbing others. Their existence through an association giving people a
heavenly pleasure. But whom they are followers of Shaytan, their existence through a community is giving
people trouble, yes. Therefore, beauty, to be beautiful or handsome, physically going to be changed if they are
not asking real beauty and handsomeness. Whom they are not asking, they are falling down. People are
asking to run away from them because their faces taking something from Shaytan's appearance.
Look at young ones, for a while you may say "they are so beautiful" or "so handsome." This is a temporary
level, but then they're reaching (maturity). Therefore, there is one knowledge reaching from the knowledge of
prophets, particularly from the Seal of Prophets (s), that if a person is reaching forty years but yet he is not
taking any care for his or her servanthood, Shaytan is kissing that one on forehead, saying, “O, I am so happy
today that this one is never following heavenly ones! That means they are registered on my book. Write their
name on my book. That means this one belongs to us, reaching to forty years and not coming to accept
heavenly ways and heavenly orders. This one belongs to me now.” Shaytan is kissing their foreheads, both
men and women. And at that time ugliness on their faces appears, more clear coming, and you are saying,
"That person look like Shaytan."
O Allah! Protect us not to follow Shaytan! And if Shaytan kissing that person on forehead, no chance to come
back on their ways, and it continues on that person's face until he is dying. Some one's faces are shining, even
on a dead body. Some one's getting to be more ugly, coming on them dhulmat, darkness on their faces.

SubhaanAllah, getting on them a very bad smelling. Sometimes people say, “We are burying that one, but
bad smelling." And after weeks, months, sometimes coming and smelling that same bad smelling through
that one’s grave. A`oodhu billah, a`oodhu billah. And some people saying that this Earth, teen, clay,

therefore, keeping body and it giving bad smell to people.
Some people are dying and their dead bodies coming so beautiful and good smell coming from them. I was in
Damascus once, and people were changing a wali's tomb to another place and they opened him, coming same
as day they buried him. Coming such good smelling and thousands of people smelling; they were taking the
body like up to your home, same distance, and people smelling that good smelling. And I was passing after so
many days and small ones bringing to me a handful of earth from that grave, and saying, “O Shaykh, smell
this," and I am smelling and it was like …[transmission lost 1.5 minutes]
A`oodhu billah. And their followers coming on same ugliness then, a little bit down, down, down. But famous
ugliness for tyrants, whom they are never keeping holy books' orders, heavenly orders, those people never
taking care for Holy Qur'an. And Allah Almighty dressing them in ugliness. Even their clothes may be
beautiful dressings, but you can't look at their faces, so darkness on their faces and bad smelling coming to
them.
Therefore, we are fighting against tyrants coming against Islam, and their followers particularly. And Hadari
`ulamas, look to their faces; they are faces of tyrants. You can know who are tyrants, you can know which
ones were bringing down good ones, that they are sultans. After sultans, all of them are representatives of
Shaytan, their appearance is of Shaytan, they are speaking shaytanic, and their out-looking (appearance) is
shaytanic. You must know this, I am speaking truth. And Hadari `ulamas , you must know this and followers
whom they are followers of Shaytan, who are against sultans and bringing them down, are followers of AntiChrist (Dajjal).
O People! Beware of tyrants! Don't give them support. People are supporting them, so they are saying, “We
just voted, we are elected by our people that we are so powerful and we are best ones.” You are cheating
people through the way of (rigging) elections! Why you are not saying, "O `ulamas of Turkey, of Damascus, of
`Ajam, of Iraq ... Why you are not saying (such false) elections are baatil (false)?" And you are saying, “we are
doing amr bi 'l-ma`roof wa 'n-nahiy `ani 'l-munkar (ordering the good and forbidding wrongdoing)." That is
biggest munkar, to take away sultans and bringing tyrants.
khaaf min Allah, fear from Allah hadari `ulamas! But are only busy for adhaa, disturbing people, saying,

"Don't stand like this in front of the tomb of Prophet (s), don't open your hands like that.'" What is that?
Nothing! Why you don't say, “Don't follow Shaytan or mumaththil, Shaytan's representatives.” Why you are
not saying? You must be happy that Hijaz malik, (king of Hijaz) has no election. But so many states, perhaps
forty, making elections.
Hadari `ulamas, so many people are coming for elections, making a heap of melons and saying to him,
“Please select one, and we shall take.” He can't know, he can’t do! Most people are not knowing to select one
bateekha, watermelon, so what about for a man? What you are saying? You are fearing from tyrants, but you
are not fearing from Allah?
Salafi `ulamas! What are your main principles? Please write and send to me what you are doing for Islam.
Please send to me and I am saying to whole Muslim world. But now is the time of tyrants, and Allah Almighty
is sending one musharraf, honored one, to be on the sunnah of the Seal of Prophets (s) and will grant to him a
heavenly power to take away those who are with the Anti-Christ, Dajjaal. If they are not doing, you will be
responsible on the Day of Resurrection!
O People! Look what you are saying and look what they are saying against our speech, that we are not
speaking from Shari`ah. We are speaking from Shari`ah and from Holy Qur'an, and whole troublemakers
and Shaytan's representatives are tyrants and against Islam!! And Allah (swt) is sending someone to take
away whole tyrants.
O whole Salafi `ulamas! You listen and hear! Look, kutub al-hadith, from books of holy hadith you may know
this and you may understand. If you are using your understanding, you may understand. Look and give lights
to people; if giving to people you will be honored here and Hereafter, or if you are with the tyrants you will be
going to the Fire.
May Allah (swt) forgives us! Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah.
(Mawlana sings Turkish song)

Dome dome dome dome 4x
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Shafa`atak, Yaa Rasoolullah! We are seeking your intercession, Yaa Rasoolullah!
Support, Yaa Rasoolullah! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Fatihah.
(38 minutes)
It is an important declaration from heavens tonight. It is enough if they are asking for understanding; if not
asking, going to reach graveyard, they are going to be tyrants and they shall be buried as tyrants.
O People! Try to follow the lights of the Seal of Prophets (s), lights of heavens. Don't remain through
darkness of this life, as those who remain with Shaytan; they are tyrants. May Allah forgives us and make us
on the way of servants, to save us and secondly, to take away Shaytan and it's followers, or nothing can be
done now to change that situation and to change into good situation, no, no, no. We are in need for
intercession, and Allah sending to take away whole tyrants.
Fatihah.
